hooks.command: echo '=== Session Start: Reading DEVELOPMENT_FLOW.md, AI_HANDOFF.md, and HANDOFF_PROMPT.md ===' && echo '--- DEVELOPMENT_FLOW.md ---' && cat DEVELOPMENT_FLOW.md && echo '--- AI_HANDOFF.md ---' && cat AI_HANDOFF.md && echo '--- HANDOFF_PROMPT.md ---' && cat .claude/HANDOFF_PROMPT.md

BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "develop" ]; then echo "Error: Refusing to make changes to branch '$BRANCH'. Please switch to a feature branch."; exit 1; fi
echo '=== Session End: Please update AI_HANDOFF.md with your handoff for the next AI ===' && echo 'Current AI_HANDOFF.md:' && cat AI_HANDOFF.md
